python3 - << 'PY'
import re
_first_cap_re = re.compile('(.)([A-Z][a-z0-9]+)')
_all_cap_re = re.compile('([a-z0-9])([A-Z])')

def camel(name):
    s1 = _first_cap_re.sub(r'\1_\2', name)
    return _all_cap_re.sub(r'\1_\2', s1).lower()

def old(dataset_name):
    chunks = []
    for part in dataset_name.split("_"):
        if part.isdigit():
            chunks[-1] = f"{chunks[-1]}_{part}"
        else:
            chunks.append(part.capitalize())
    return "".join(chunks)

def new(dataset_name):
    chunks = []
    for part in dataset_name.split("_"):
        if part.isdigit():
            if not chunks:
                raise ValueError(dataset_name)
            chunks[-1] = f"{chunks[-1]}_{part}"
        elif part[:1].isdigit():
            chunks.append(f"_{part}")
        else:
            chunks.append(part.capitalize())
    return "".join(chunks)

names = [
    "grasp_conveyor_rand_speed_2",
    "grasp_conveyor_block",
    "demo_block_20hz_2",
    "put_back_block",
    "place_color_count_blocks_tray_rand",
]
for n in names:
    o, nw = old(n), new(n)
    print(f"{n:40} old={o:35} -> {camel(o):40} new={nw:35} -> {camel(nw)}")
PY

put_back_block                           old=PutBackBlock                        -> put_back_block                           new=PutBackBlock                        -> put_back_block
place_color_count_blocks_tray_rand       old=PlaceColorCountBlocksTrayRand       -> place_color_count_blocks_tray_rand       new=PlaceColorCountBlocksTrayRand       -> place_color_count_blocks_tray_rand
